name: Ligne 18 : gare Université Paris-Saclay
about: Université Paris-Saclay's station (ex Orsay-Gif, plateau de Moulon) on line 18's master plan (lots/ligne18/ligne18_plan.gd: its frame and levels; ref/metro18/ §3, §5) and its grounds up to the roads round it (lots/ligne18-universite/universite_plan.gd): the deck over its zone (u -45..45, its top at deck_top_z, the line's section at its ends; the viaduct's lot lays the tracks on it), the cross-beams at u +-45 the viaduct's first spans rest on and the hall's two single piers; the white socle with the hall at the ground (its glazed ends under the deck, west to rue Sophie Germain, east to rue Nicolas Appert, its south door to the TCSP), the passerelle across it, on each side a stair, an escalator and a glass lift up to the side platforms (60 m, edge at |v| 4.00, glass screens); the folded glass envelope in white frames (nine folds a side), its roof of glass and white panels with yellow slats under them. Its grounds: the TCSP's north kerb, a strip with the lamps, a two-way cycle track and the sidewalk; the sidewalks along rue Sophie Germain and rue Nicolas Appert; the forecourts west and east under the viaduct (groves, benches, bike racks), south along the facade (birches) and north under the envelope; the promenade under the viaduct to rue Nicolas Appert, a path across the north-east lawn; mown lawns, trees in rows clear of the axis and of the viaduct's piers; rue Sophie Germain's and the TCSP's carriageways redone (kerbs, centre lines, the cycle track's crossing), the stop « Université Paris-Saclay » on the TCSP's south side (its platform, kerb and zigzag). The ground flat at the doors (hall_z), eased to the roads' levels (the TCSP regraded flatter along the station). Out of the map: the station #7056 (osm:w1063329862), the construction site's trees, props, kerbs and markings in the perimeter.
